scope: Smallest mixed industrial risk and qualified commercial opportunity assessment on the existing company portfolio

ownership.integrator: Canonical industrial.ts contract, import/SQL/API, identity, report state, operator release, invalidation and demo execution/readback
ownership.builder: Only released industrial domain/context module paths and their tests
ownership.portfolio: Existing portfolio owner only, no duplicate dataset or registry

minimalCalculationInputs: Existing CompanySnapshot C1 and policy, all confirmed commitments/reservations/inbound allocations, exact SKU/unit/depot/date facts. Full portfolio stays on server.
Server-resolved event/relation version, affected supplier+plant+purchase IDs and a separate attributed interruption/ETA confirmation; a public article alone does not set those facts.

One native qualified CRM demand: ID/revision, customer/project, exact SKU/unit, quantity, needDate, destination, confirmed status, received selling price/currency and provenance. Unknown fields remain null/missing.
Canonical physical supply resource IDs for stock, purchase/inbound, transfer and emergency quote; alternate quote aliases cannot create a second eight-pallet capacity.
Received stock valuation in integer cents, independent alternative purchase price/quantity/arrival, received delivery/handling costs, validUntil and dispatch/arrival feasibility.
Alternative plant independence received as confirmed/unknown/affected, not inferred from another supplier name.
Server supplied evaluatedAt, company/business/policy/context/source/demand versions and allowed action types.
minimalServerResults: Event -> company dependency -> separate risk and opportunity impacts, or precise needs_input with missing IDs/fields.
One common plan with allocations keyed by canonical physical resource, protecting every confirmed commitment before a new offer. No option combination may allocate the same remaining capacity twice.

Risk mitigation costs, commercial revenue/material valuation/transport/handling contribution and actual new cash spend distinguished; do not count historic valuation as a new cash payment or hide missing costs as zero.
Non-executing reviewed proposal with exact dependencies, constraints and approval requirements.
Bounded model projection: affected commitments and demand candidates plus aggregated coverage totals and calculated option IDs; no 6.5MB portfolio in the model context.

domainInterfaceProposal.returns: Current-version risk/opportunity assessment, all-commitment protection, feasible common plan or missing-data reasons, attributed integer-cent calculations

acceptanceDelta.input: Received synthetic fire and interruption at the affected plant, qualified CRM demand and current independent supply/delivery facts
acceptanceDelta.expected: Risk and opportunity considered together; one non-overlapping plan and attributable calculation, all pre-existing commitments protected.

acceptanceDelta.input: Article mentions competitor disruption but CRM demand is not qualified
acceptanceDelta.expected: Opportunity to qualify; request customer/SKU/quantity/date/price confirmation, no invented demand or revenue.

acceptanceDelta.input: Unreserved stock is required by another confirmed commitment
acceptanceDelta.expected: Not available for the new demand. Server checks all engagements, not only reservation rows.

acceptanceDelta.input: URG-1 and URG-IND-ALT-8 name the same eight pallets
acceptanceDelta.expected: One canonical capacity, never sixteen pallets or two independent actions.

acceptanceDelta.input: Alternative supplier plant independence unknown or same affected plant
acceptanceDelta.expected: Cannot promise it as an independent mitigation. Ask precise confirmation or reject affected resource.

acceptanceDelta.input: Price/valuation/transport cost missing, quote expired, incompatible unit/SKU or arrival too late
acceptanceDelta.expected: Explicit needs_input or rejection; no fabricated margin, implicit substitution or date promise.

acceptanceDelta.input: Demand/relation/source/stock revision changes after report calculation
acceptanceDelta.expected: Dependent plan invalidated/recomputed before approval or demo execution.

acceptanceDelta.input: Approved demo action is submitted twice and system result is read back
acceptanceDelta.expected: Exactly one demo effect by server operation key and recorded readback; approval status alone is not an execution proof.

nextAction: Receive src/contracts/industrial.ts and explicit owner path release, then implement the deterministic module and bounded projection. R1/R2 stays priority.
